faqs.a:
Any dead animal shall be disposed of by the owner or custodian within 24 hours of
               death by burial, incineration in a state approved facility, rendering, or other state
               approved means. No dead animal shall be dumped or abandoned on any public or private
               property.
(Code 1981, § 6-64; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
State Law reference—
Disposition of dead animals, C.R.S. § 25-1-612.
